mentions.name: Second-Gen Multi-Device Harness
mentions.description: A second-generation multi-device harness built to the same quality bar as Sublime Text, with potential delivery as SaaS for security and reliability reasons; at minimum a personal tool for the author.
mentions.problem: Existing multi-device tooling falls short of the quality the author wants, prompting a proper second-generation rebuild; commercial viability is still uncertain.
mentions.source_excerpt: ive been slowly working on my ideas for a proper second gen multi device harness that i want to be in the same quality regime as sublime text. unclear if theres a viable commercial market (and for a variety of reasons around user security and reliability thinking mebe saas). at the very least i want nice things for me.
mentions.author: carterschonwald
